notes.title: New Version 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Update Notes

We’re thrilled to share the exciting improvements and updates in our latest version! Here's what's new and enhanced:

Enhanced Gameplay and Features:

Improved Notebook Readability: All notes in the bill notebook have been refined for better clarity and readability.

Table Direction Indicators: Arrows have been added to indicate table orientations, making navigation and placement easier.

Dynamic Customer Patience: Customers now have a randomized waiting time between 30 to 60 seconds for added realism and challenge.

Numpad for Credit Card Payments: A numpad interface has been added to the payment screen for smoother credit card transactions.

Language and Localization:

Language Improvements: Corrected several wording errors across different languages to ensure a more polished experience.

Comprehensive Translation Overhaul: All supported languages have been retranslated and updated for accuracy and immersion.

Chinese Font Size Fix: Resolved font size issues in Chinese text to enhance readability.

Exciting New Additions:

Waiter System Introduced: A waiter has been added to the game! Currently, they can take orders and process payments (delivering food to tables coming soon!).

Default Jukebox Installed: Enjoy in-game music with the newly added jukebox. Players can now create a cozy atmosphere with their favorite tunes.

Autosave Feature: Your progress is now automatically saved, ensuring a seamless gaming experience.

Game Balance and Optimization:

Balanced In-Game Economy: Adjustments have been made to ensure a fair and engaging economic system.

We’re committed to making Morning Brew the best experience it can be. Your feedback has been instrumental in these updates, and we’re excited to hear your thoughts on these new changes. Thank you for your continued support, and happy brewing!
